title: Sr Full Stack Engineer - Python, Node, React, Typescript, GenAI
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Full Stack Engineer to design, build, and scale modern, AI-powered digital products and rich data-driven experiences. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in React, TypeScript, and Node.js, with a passion for creating intuitive dashboards, analytics platforms, and enterprise-grade web applications.

This role combines solid full-stack engineering capabilities with practical experience in Python and Generative AI technologies, enabling the development of intelligent applications, AI assistants, agent-based workflows, and advanced user experiences. You will work closely with product, AI/ML, design, and platform teams to deliver scalable, secure, and resilient solutions that drive business outcomes.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Design and develop modern, responsive, and highly interactive web applications using React, TypeScript, and Node.js
* Build rich dashboards, analytics portals, data visualization experiences, and executive reporting solutions that deliver actionable insights
* Develop scalable backend services, APIs, and microservices that power web, mobile, and AI-driven experiences
* Design reusable and channel-agnostic APIs that support multiple consumer applications and intelligent agent experiences
* Build and integrate Generative AI solutions, including:
* Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) applications
* Prompt engineering and tool-calling capabilities
* Develop Python-based services and AI orchestration layers supporting machine learning and LLM-powered applications
* Create intuitive user experiences that simplify complex business processes and workflows
* Implement observability, monitoring, analytics, and usage dashboards to measure application and AI system performance
* Drive engineering excellence through automated testing, code reviews, CI/CD pipelines, and modern DevOps practices
* Collaborate with architects, AI/ML engineers, product managers, UX designers, and platform teams to deliver secure and scalable solutions
* Evaluate emerging technologies, frameworks, and AI capabilities to continuously improve engineering effectiveness and product innovation
* Ensure compliance with organizational security, governance, and responsible AI standards
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 6+ years of professional software engineering experience in full-stack application development
* Hands-on experience building and deploying Generative AI applications using modern LLM platforms and frameworks
* Experience with:
  + AI agents and agent orchestration
  + RAG architectures
  + Vector search and embeddings
  + Prompt engineering
  + Tool/function calling
* Experience designing and developing RESTful APIs and microservices architectures
* Experience deploying applications in cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or GCP
* Experience implementing automated testing strategies and maintaining high-quality engineering standards
* AI-powered search and recommendation experiences
* Proven experience building enterprise-grade dashboards, data visualizations, and analytics applications
* Solid expertise in:
  + React.js
  + TypeScript
  + JavaScript
  + Node.js
  + HTML5/CSS3
* Knowledge of AI assistants and copilots
* Knowledge of Agentic workflows
* Solid understanding of CI/CD, containerization, DevOps, and modern software delivery practices
* Solid proficiency in Python for backend services, automation, AI integration, or data processing workloads
* Proven ability to own and deliver solutions end-to-end, from architecture and design through deployment and support

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* B.E or B.Tech in computer science or information technology or equivalent
* Experience building enterprise AI platforms, copilots, intelligent assistants, or conversational applications
* Experience with advanced data visualization frameworks such as D3.js, Recharts, Highcharts, or similar technologies
* Experience integrating applications with enterprise collaboration and productivity tools
* Experience working in Agile product teams and leading technical initiatives
* Healthcare, health-tech, or regulated industry experience
* Solid understanding of cloud-native architectures and distributed systems
* Familiarity with AI evaluation frameworks, model observability, and AI governance practices
* Exposure to AI coding assistants and modern AI-powered development workflows
* Demonstrated solid problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex business challenges into elegant technical solutions
* Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers and influence technical direction across teams

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: Full Stack Developer - Python & React
description:
**About US:-**

We turn customer challenges into growth opportunities. Material is a global strategy partner to the world’s most recognizable brands and innovative companies. Our people around the globe thrive by helping organizations design and deliver rewarding customer experiences.

We use deep human insights, design innovation and data to create experiences powered by modern technology. Our approaches speed engagement and growth for the companies we work with and transform relationships between businesses and the people they serve.

Srijan, a Material company, is a renowned global digital engineering firm with a reputation for solving complex technology problems using their deep technology expertise and leveraging strategic partnerships with top-tier technology partners. Be a part of an Awesome Tribe

  

**Role:**

The engineer should have strong software engineering experience with a focus on Python-based backend services, Generative AI solutions, React.js applications, and modern development and deployment practices.

**Python**

* Strong proficiency in Python and modern Python development practices.
* Experience building maintainable, production-grade backend services and REST APIs, preferably using FastAPI.
* Good understanding of object-oriented programming, type hints, exception handling, dependency management, and application architecture.
* Experience writing unit and integration tests using tools such as pytest.
* Ability to debug, profile, and optimize Python applications.

**Generative AI**

* Hands-on experience building and integrating Generative AI and Large Language Model (LLM)-based applications.
* Experience working with LLM APIs, prompt engineering, structured outputs, tool/function calling, and agentic workflows.
* Understanding of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), embeddings, vector search, and grounding techniques.
* Experience integrating GenAI capabilities into production-grade backend services and APIs.
* Familiarity with LLM evaluation, guardrails, hallucination mitigation, observability, latency, and cost optimization.
* Experience with leading GenAI frameworks, model providers, and orchestration tools is preferred.
* Understanding of responsible AI, data privacy, security, and safe deployment practices for GenAI applications.

**React.js**

* Strong proficiency in React.js and modern JavaScript/TypeScript development.
* Experience building responsive, maintainable, and production-grade web applications.
* Good understanding of component-based architecture, state management, hooks, routing, and frontend performance optimization.
* Experience integrating React applications with REST APIs and backend services.
* Familiarity with frontend testing, build tooling, dependency management, and modern development practices.

**MongoDB**

* Hands-on experience with MongoDB in production applications.
* Ability to design appropriate document schemas and data models.
* Experience writing MongoDB queries and aggregation pipelines.
* Understanding of indexes, query optimization, and database performance.
* Experience integrating MongoDB with Python using PyMongo, Motor, or equivalent libraries.

**Docker**

* Strong understanding of Docker and containerized application development.
* Ability to create secure and efficient Dockerfiles.
* Experience using Docker Compose for local development and service orchestration.
* Understanding of container networking, volumes, environment configuration, and troubleshooting.

**CI/CD**

* Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
* Ability to automate code quality checks, testing, Docker image creation, and deployment.
* Experience with GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or equivalent CI/CD platforms.
* Understanding of branching strategies, release workflows, environment management, and deployment automation.

**General Engineering**

* Strong Git and code-review practices.
* Understanding of API design, application security, logging, monitoring, and observability.
* Comfortable working with Linux-based development and production environments.
* Ability to troubleshoot issues across application, AI/LLM, database, container, and deployment layers.
* Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to design scalable, reliable, and maintainable solutions.

**Skills:**

* Minimum of 4-6 years of experience. Skills required are
* Python Backend Engineering – Strong Python development skills with experience building production-grade backend services, APIs, testing, debugging, and performance optimization.
* Generative AI / LLM Engineering – Experience building GenAI applications using LLMs, RAG, embeddings, prompt engineering, tool calling, agentic workflows, and evaluation techniques.
* React.js Frontend Development – Strong experience building modern, responsive web applications using React.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, hooks, state management, and API integrations.
* MongoDB & NoSQL Development – Hands-on experience with MongoDB data modeling, aggregation pipelines, indexing, query optimization, and Python integration.
* Docker & Containerization – Strong experience containerizing applications, writing efficient Dockerfiles, using Docker Compose, and troubleshooting container environments.
* CI/CD & DevOps Automation – Experience designing automated pipelines for testing, code quality, builds, releases, and deployments using modern CI/CD platforms.
* API & Microservices Architecture – Strong understanding of REST APIs, service-oriented architecture, scalable backend design, and production application architecture.
* Production Engineering & Observability – Experience with Git, Linux, application security, logging, monitoring, troubleshooting, and operating reliable production systems.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
**Senior Software Engineer, Backend and Platform**

**About this role**

The Senior Software Engineer, Backend and Platform will help build Prudential Japan's next

generation Product Engineering capabilities as part of the Japan Technology Transformation

initiative.

This role is responsible for designing, building, and operating digital products and platforms that

support customer journeys, sales journeys, policy administration experiences, and business

workflows across Prudential Japan's end-to-end journey of life insurance value streams.

As part of a newly established Product Engineering organization, this role offers the opportunity

not only to build products, but also to help establish engineering practices, standards, and ways

of working that will shape the future of technology delivery at Prudential Japan.

What you could work on

We allocate after offer, across multiple domains. Policy administration, where contract truth must

survive multiple years and a change to old insurance product must never silently break tens of

thousands of live contracts. Customer communications, where essential customer

communications reach every customer in one immovable window. CRM, where customer and

agent information and interactions are managed consistently across products and channels.

New business and policy issuance, where an application must move accurately from initial

submission through underwriting and approval to a legally effective insurance contract.

Integration, where the industry wide used services, banking and government systems meet our

systems. And the compliance records, which are essential to maintain as an insurer.

**Key Responsibilities**

Design, build and continuously improve backend services and data models for systems of

record, where a change can alter an obligation the company owes a customer rather than only

an applicationʼs behavior.

Create, maintain and enhance software capabilities and functionality across modern

technology stacks, integrations and the full software lifecycle.

Own integrations with external parties you do not control, including government and banking

systems, shared industry data services and print and delivery vendors.

Build and operate scheduled and batch processing that must finish inside a fixed window,

including month end and year end cycles.

Build and extend the audit and evidence layer: what was shown, agreed, triggered and paid,

retrievable for years.

Work closely with systems engineers, architects and business partners to ensure the quality

and reliability of the product, and to deliver on business objectives.

Work alongside long-lived legacy systems and decide, case by case, what to wrap, what to

replace and what to leave alone.

Engage with broader product considerations and planning across ideation, design,

development, testing, business engagement and team leadership.

Carry on-call for what you own, and run incident reviews that look for causes rather than for

someone to blame.

**Qualifications**

**General**

You do not need insurance experience. We will teach the domain.

Five or more years building and operating backend systems in production, including

ownership of something that mattered when it broke.

Strong data modelling, especially temporal and bitemporal data modelling.

Transactional integrity, idempotency and reconciliation as daily practice rather than interview

vocabulary.

Integrating with external organizations where the interface is theirs and will not change for

you.

Real-time as well as batch processing at scale, with a working understanding of time windows

and dependency chains.

Any high consequence or regulated domain is an advantage: payments, healthcare, logistics,

energy, safety-critical systems.

Degree in relevant field or equivalent practical experience.

**Technical**

We run on AWS. We are not dogmatic about languages or frameworks and we do not screen

on keyword matches: we care that you have gone deep in at least one stack and can pick up

another. Depth in one column beats a shallow tick in all of them.

AI assisted development: Claude, Codex, Copilot or Cursor. Knowing how to build Agent skills

is an advantage.

**Languages:** Java or Kotlin, Go, Python or TypeScript on Node.

Data: PostgreSQL or Aurora as the default. Experience with schema evolution on live data

matters more than any particular engine.

AWS Ecosystem

Integration: REST and event-driven patterns, plus the older shapes you will meet at the

boundary, including scheduled file exchange and message queues.

Infrastructure as code and CI/CD: Terraform or CDK or Ansible, with pipelines you have

owned rather than inherited.

Observability: Structured logging, metrics and tracing. CloudWatch, OpenTelemetry,

Dynatrace, or Datadog

Nice to have: Kafka or Kinesis, and any experience bridging a mainframe or vendor package

to modern services.

**Language**

English: Fluent to Native

Japanese: Working level. JLPT N2 or native is an advantage.

**Culture and Leadership Expectations**

* Act as One Prudential for customers by building integrated products across business

domains

* Drive Change by modernizing legacy systems and improving engineering practices
* Be Highly Accountable for code quality, delivery, reliability, and production outcomes
* Engage with Candor through open collaboration and constructive technical discussion
* Demonstrate core values: Worthy of Trust, Customer Focused, Respect for Each Other, and

Winning with Integrit

**Skills:** AWS , Java or Kotlin, Go, Python or TypeScript on Node , PostgreSQL or Aurora

title: FULL STACK DEVELOPER
description:
**ABOUT THE ROLE**
------------------

We are looking for highly skilled Full Stack Developers to join the iDeploy Engineering team and contribute to the next generation of Airtel's enterprise-scale digital transformation platforms.

The selected candidates will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining highly scalable, secure, and performance-driven web applications supporting end-to-end telecom deployment, project governance, workflow automation, inventory integration, and analytics.

This role requires strong expertise across both frontend and backend technologies, with a focus on **Angular 19+, Node.js/NestJS, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Microservices, and Enterprise Integrations.**

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**
------------------------

### **1. Frontend Development**

* Design and develop responsive, scalable, and high-performance web applications using Angular 19+.
* Build modern user interfaces using Standalone Components, Signals, and Signal-based State Management.
* Develop reusable UI components, directives, pipes, and shared libraries.
* Implement Reactive Forms, Template-Driven Forms, Routing, Lazy Loading, Route Guards, Dependency Injection, and HTTP Interceptors.
* Utilize Angular's latest template control flow features such as @if, @for, and @switch.
* Ensure responsive design and compatibility across browsers and devices.
* Optimize UI performance, rendering efficiency, and user experience.

### **2. Backend Development**

* Develop robust and scalable applications using Node.js, ExpressJS, and NestJS.
* Design and build secure REST APIs and Microservices.
* Implement API versioning, middleware, request validation, exception handling, and Swagger/OpenAPI documentation.
* Integrate applications with enterprise systems, third-party services, and external APIs.
* Participate in architecture discussions and solution design activities.

* Develop efficient schemas, aggregation pipelines, and complex SQL queries.
* Optimize database performance through indexing, query tuning, partitioning, and performance analysis.
* Implement transactional processing, data integrity checks, and scalable data access patterns.

* Ensure secure coding practices and adherence to security standards.
* Develop audit logging, access controls, and compliance-related features.

### **5. DevOps & Support**

* Support CI/CD implementation using Jenkins or similar tools.
* Deploy and manage applications across Development, UAT, and Production environments.
* Work on Linux-based environments and application hosting configurations.
* Participate in production support, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and performance optimization.

**REQUIRED TECHNICAL SKILLS**
-----------------------------

### **Frontend Technologies**

* **Angular 19+ (Mandatory)**
* Standalone Components
* Signals & Signal-based State Management
* RxJS, Observables, Subjects, BehaviorSubjects
* Reactive Forms & Template Driven Forms
* Angular Routing & Lazy Loading
* Route Guards
* Dependency Injection
* HTTP Interceptors
* TypeScript
* JavaScript (ES6+)
* HTML5
* CSS3 / SCSS
* Bootstrap

### **Backend Technologies**

* Node.js
* ExpressJS
* NestJS
* REST API Development
* Microservices Architecture
* Swagger/OpenAPI
* Request Validation
* Middleware Development
* Exception Handling
* API Versioning

### **Database Technologies**

**MongoDB**

* Schema Design
* Aggregation Pipelines
* Indexing
* Query Optimization
* Replica Sets
* Transactions
* Performance Tuning

**PostgreSQL**

* Complex SQL Queries
* Views
* Stored Procedures
* Indexing
* Partitioning
* Database Performance Optimization

### **Security**

* OAuth2
* RBAC
* ACL
* Single Sign-On (SSO)

### **DevOps & Infrastructure**

* Jenkins / CI-CD
* Linux Administration (RHEL/Ubuntu)

* SSL Certificate Management
* Reverse Proxy Configuration
* Load Balancing Concepts

### **Monitoring & Logging**

* Centralized Logging
* Health Monitoring
* Application Observability
* Production Performance Monitoring

* Jasmine
* Unit Testing
* Integration Testing

**DESIRED CANDIDATE PROFILE**
-----------------------------

* Strong understanding of enterprise application architecture and design patterns.
* Experience building high-volume, transaction-intensive business applications.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently and drive solutions end-to-end.

* Experience in telecom, workflow management, enterprise platforms, or digital transformation projects will be preferred.

**WHY JOIN IDEPLOY?**
---------------------

You will have the opportunity to work on one of Airtel's flagship digital transformation platforms that supports nationwide network deployment and operational excellence.

The role offers exposure to large-scale enterprise architecture, telecom domain challenges, modern technology stacks, AI-led automation initiatives, and opportunities to influence solutions used by thousands of internal and partner users across India.

title: Senior IT Pillar Specialist
description:
**Job Overview:**

The Full Stack Developer position provides technical expertise in building modern solutions using AI\-assisted tools responsibly to accelerate discovery, prototyping, development, testing, and documentation without compromising architecture, security, code quality, or accountability. The role expects reliable delivery of business outcomes with predictable quality, security, and operational readiness by reducing lead time from concept to production through automation, reusable patterns, and effective AI\-assisted engineering. Transformation using Production\-grade web applications and digital services that solve measurable business problems with reusable front\-end components, APIs, microservices, integration patterns, and engineering standards that improve delivery speed across teams. The ideal candidate should have experience expertise in .NET Core, React, Python, and Azure and should leverage GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and AI\-assisted development tools.


  
Our ingenuity fuels daily life. Together, we’ve forged some of the most trusted partnerships across the energy value chain to make what was once just an idea a reality: laying subsea infrastructure thousands of feet below sea level, installing platforms hundreds of miles from shore, using our expertise to design and build offshore wind infrastructure, and reshaping the onshore landscape to deliver the energy products the world needs safely and sustainably.
  

  

For more than 100 years, we've been making the impossible possible. Today, we're driving the energy transition with more than 30,000 of the brightest minds across 54 countries.
  
**Key Tasks and Responsibilities:**

* Lead end\-to\-end solution delivery, including technical discovery, architecture, development, testing, deployment, and post\-production support
* Build accessible, responsive, and high\-performing user experiences using React, Next.js, TypeScript, and modern UI practices
* Design and implement secure REST APIs using Microservices architecture with .NET / ASP.NET Core, C\#, Python, and FastAPI or Flask
* Engineer solutions using appropriate platform services, managed identities, secrets management, monitoring, and cost\-conscious design. Implement secure authentication, authorization, and data protection mechanisms
* Integrate applications with Enterprise platforms, Relational and NoSQL databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis) , Messaging services, and Third\-party APIs
* Implement CI/CD pipelines and DevOps best practices using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes (Preferred)
* Use GitHub Copilot, Cursor Prompt Engineering, AI\-Based Code Generation, Automated Unit Test Generation,
AI\-Assisted Debugging \& Refactoring to accelerate development tasks while retaining full ownership of design and code decisions. Create effective prompts and context patterns for code generation, refactoring, test creation, debugging, documentation, and technical discovery
* Validate AI\-generated output for correctness, maintainability, licensing, security, privacy, and alignment with enterprise standards before use. Establish automated quality controls through unit, integration, API, security, and regression testing
* Protect confidential information by following approved\-tool, data\-handling, and source\-code governance requirements
* Optimise and standardize by identifying repeatable AI\-assisted workflows and convert them into documented, measurable engineering practices rather than one\-off experimentation
* Apply security\-by\-design practices across authentication, authorization, data protection, dependency management, and secure coding
* Collaborate professionally with Business SMEs, Developers, Architects, product owners, UX, security, operations, and business stakeholders
* Product mindset with strong ownership from problem definition through production outcomes
* Sound engineering judgement and the ability to balance speed, risk, maintainability, and business value
* Excellent verbal and written communication in English with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Curiosity, adaptability, and a disciplined approach to continuous learning and experimentation

  
**Essential Qualifications and Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology or a related field
* 8\+ years total experience with 6\+ years of hands\-on full stack software engineering experience, including ownership of production applications
* Strong expertise in .NET / ASP.NET Core, C\#, React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS and responsive design
* Proficiency in Python and at least one modern API framework such as FastAPI or Flask
* Demonstrated experience designing REST APIs, microservices, integration layers, and distributed application components
* Practical Azure experience, including App Service, Functions, Storage, Key Vault, monitoring, identity, and deployment services
* Solid understanding of automated testing, Git workflows, CI/CD, Docker, application security, performance tuning, and observability
* Core exposure to GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Prompt Engineering, AI\-Based Code Generation
* Exposure to ITIL Principles and Change management process
